item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We are clear: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We refuse to accept that future. Preventing it must come before the race to build it.

2. We oppose building superintelligent AI within the next 20 years because it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We demand binding limits on development. No company's ambitions justify that loss of life.

3. We will not call a billion deaths the price of progress. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe on that scale. We must stop this race, not celebrate its winners.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe humanity deserves a future, not a race toward catastrophe. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We cannot accept that outcome as the cost of innovation, and we will not let promises of prosperity excuse it. We are calling for binding limits that prevent this technology from being built on that timeline, backed by independent oversight and international cooperation. Our task is to turn public concern into collective action. We must put human lives ahead of corporate competition—and make preventing this catastrophe a political priority now.
